# Official Odin Resources

Use these sources first.

## Primary URLs
- Documentation index: https://odin-lang.org/docs/
- Language overview: https://odin-lang.org/docs/overview/
- Package documentation: https://pkg.odin-lang.org/
- Examples index: https://odin-lang.org/docs/examples/
- Nightly builds: https://odin-lang.org/docs/nightly/
- News and articles: https://odin-lang.org/news

## How to Use Them
- Start with the documentation index to locate the correct top-level section.
- Use the overview for language semantics, syntax, operators, directives, types, and idioms.
- Use the package site for concrete API lookup in `base`, `core`, and `vendor` packages.
- Use the examples index to jump to official demo and examples repositories.
- Use nightly builds and news pages when the answer depends on recency or release drift.

## Notes
- The docs index links to install, overview, packages, examples, demo file, testing, nightly builds, and FAQ.
- The package site is the primary API reference for official packages.
- The overview page explicitly recommends consulting the demo file, tests, and source tree when the prose documentation is incomplete.
- The examples page links both the official `demo.odin` and the `odin-lang/examples` repository.
- The nightly page exposes dated nightly builds and links to GitHub tagged releases.
- The news page is the official article and newsletter archive and is useful for change context.
